beats.say: Four against one: Michael Myers dominates the new Halloween video game.
Halloween: The Game launched on 8 September 2026 across PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X, Series S, and Windows, built entirely in Unreal Engine 5.
The multiplayer experience pits four civilian players against one hunter controlling Michael Myers in intense online asymmetrical horror battles.
However, the Australian Classification Board refused classification for the title entirely, effectively banning its release across Australia.
When regulators block a title, regional account restrictions mean players in Australia cannot access it, turning a global launch into a local blackout.
Would you play as Michael Myers or try to survive as a civilian?

facts: Halloween: The Game was released on September 8, 2026, for PlayStation 5, Windows, and Xbox Series X and Series S.
The game is being developed in Unreal Engine 5.
The multiplayer mode is a one-versus-four asymmetrical horror mode where one player controls Michael Myers and four players control civilians.
The game was refused classification by the Australian Classification Board, preventing its release in Australia.
